name: claude-cut
description: Video pipeline for prompter-scripted YouTube videos. edit-takes (standalone, as before) transcribes the master audio, syncs A/B roll, keeps the last take of each script section honouring the spoken 'retake cut' marker, and exports a DaVinci Resolve timeline. The full pipeline adds paper-edit, director (TH/VO split and prompters), voiceover cuts (--vo), conform and assemble, taking a finished script to an assembled Resolve timeline with markers.
